answer: The falcon consensus architecture enforces a deterministic quorum threshold Q > 2/3n within a 3f+1 Byzantine fault tolerant framework, ensuring any two subsets intersect by at least one honest node. Through a lotus epoch-based staking mechanism, we impose slashing penalties on collateral that render the expected utility of an attack strictly negative. By coupling these with juniper zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions, the system achieves state-machine replication where malicious collusion is mathematically precluded and a robust Nash equilibrium is secured.
